prefLabel: Outputs a monoband image which is the result of a mathematical operation on several multi-band images.
definition: This application performs a mathematical operation on several multi-band images and outputs the result into a monoband image. The given expression is computed at each pixel position. Evaluation of the mathematical formula is done by the muParser library.The formula can be written using:* numerical values ( 2.3, -5, 3.1e4, ...)* variables containing pixel values (e.g. ``im2b3`` is the pixel value in 2nd image, 3rd band)* binary operators: * ``+`` addition, ``-`` subtraction, ``*`` multiplication, ``/`` division * ``^`` raise x to the power of y * ``

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Generic band math (muParser expression over an input image list `il`, output forced monoband): the same closeMatch reasoning as W1's `algae-bloom.calculate-band` (also gdal_calc.py-style band math) -- reduce_dimension over the `bands` dimension with a callback built from math processes. The expression is free text here (muParser syntax), a process graph in openEO.
